description_en: Queries the certificates associated with a deployment task, such as the certificate instance ID, type, and name
description_zh: 创建部署任务后，可通过本接口获取部署到云产品的证书基本信息，例如证书实例ID、证书类型、证书名称等
name: ListDeploymentJobCert

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task from the JobId parameter. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task
parameters.help_zh: 部署任务ID。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html返回的任务**ID**。也可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html接口获取
parameters.name: job_id

Algorithm.description_en: The algorithm of the certificate public key

CertInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the certificate

CertOrderType.description_en:
The type of the certificate order. Valid values:

upload: uploaded certificate.

buy: purchased certificate.

free: free certificate. This value is available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
CertOrderType.description_zh:
证书订单类型。

upload：上传证书
buy：自购证书
free：个人测试证书（仅中国站）

CommonName.description_en: The common name of the certificate

IsTrustee.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is hosted. Valid values:

true

false
IsTrustee.description_zh:
是否托管。

true：已托管。
false：未托管

Month.description_en: The month in which the certificate is applied for

NotAfterTime.description_en: The end time of the validity period of the certificate. The value is a timestamp in seconds
NotAfterTime.description_zh: 证书有效期截止时间（秒，时间戳格式）

NotBeforeTime.description_en: The start time of the validity period of the certificate. The value is a timestamp in seconds
NotBeforeTime.description_zh: 证书有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）

OrderId.description_en:
The ID of the certificate order.

If CertId is returned, this parameter is not returned
OrderId.description_zh:
证书订单ID。
返回CertId后，则不会返回该参数

Sans.description_en: The subject alternative name (SAN) extensions of the certificate

items.description_en: The extended domain name of the certificate

StatusCode.description_en:
The status code of the certificate. Valid values:

payed: paid and pending application

checking: being validated

checkedFail: validation failed

revoked: revoked

revokeChecking: revocation request being validated

issued: issued (excluding hosted certificates that are issued, certificates that are about to expire, expired certificates, and uploaded certificates)

trustee: hosted and issued

upload: uploaded (excluding certificates that are about to expire and expired certificates)

willExpired: about to expire (including certificates issued by using the Certificate Management Service (CAS) console and uploaded certificates)

expired: expired (including certificates issued by using the CAS console and uploaded certificates)

validity: valid (including certificates that are not expired or revoked)

refund: refunded

closed: closed
StatusCode.description_zh:
证书状态码。

payed：已付款，待申请
checking：审核中
checkedFail：审核失败
revoked：吊销
revokeChecking：吊销审核中
issued：已签发，不包含已经托管的签发证书、即将过期的证书、已经过期证书、上传等
trustee：已签发的托管证书
upload：上传证书，不包含即将过期和已经过期的证书
willExpired：即将过期，包含控制台签发和上传证书
expired：已经过期，包括签发和上传的证书
validity：有效证书，包含所有未过期、未吊销证书
refund：退款
closed：关闭

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
